description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the server-side identity verification operation ExecuteServerSideVerification
description_zh: 本文介绍人脸核身服务端ExecuteServerSideVerification的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun facebody execute-server-side-verification --certificate-name '张三' --certificate-number 1281739873298172981 --facial-picture-data /9j/wwew... --facial-picture-url http://xxx.xxx.com/xxx.jpg --scene-type server --api-version 2020-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecuteServerSideVerification

parameters.help_en: The real name of the person
parameters.name: certificate_name

parameters.help_en:
Use either this parameter or facialPictureUrl.
The image to be compared, in Base64 format. Only JPG format is supported. The value must start with "/9j/". If it does not start with "/9j/", check whether the image is in JPG format. For information about Base64 encoding, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
parameters.help_zh:
与facialPictureUrl二选一。
待比对的图像，Base64格式，只支持JPG格式图片。必须是"/9j/"开头，如非"/9j/"开头请检查是否为JPG格式图片。文件的Base64编码处理操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
parameters.name: facial_picture_data

parameters.help_en:
Use either this parameter or facialPictureData.
The URL of the image to be compared. Only JPG format is supported. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh:
与facialPictureData二选一。
待比对的图像URL地址，只支持JPG格式图片。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: facial_picture_url

parameters.help_en: The scenario type. Default value: `server`. Only `server` is supported
parameters.help_zh: 场景类型，默认为`server`。目前只支持`server`
parameters.name: scene_type
